sample_unit: admission requests / federated learning runs on PathMNIST
unlisted_practices: Federated governance admission gateway issuing explicit ALLOW/DENY decisions with holder-bound capabilities before federated learning operations
Signed, independently verifiable decision evidence for each admission request
Sponsored contributor participation in federated learning with restricted capabilities (training updates but no model inference)
Bounded AI-agent participation with policy-authorized derivative transformation governed independently from source

screen.reason: The study tests an architectural and governance safeguard (Open Health admission gateway with capability-bound access control and signed decision evidence) for federated health AI and agentic systems using PathMNIST.
